svg.title: Three Qwen3-30B-A3B files against Qwen's float32 model over the same 2,000 positions: the official Q4_K_M at 18.56 GB reads 0.0909 mean KLD and fails the 0.05 bar; our 17.99 GB selective file reads 0.0279; the 17.11 GB file runner derive made reads 0.0290
